title: Returning after a test not all the coils heat and even on high areas are cold
text: Returning after a test not all the coils heat and even on high areas are cold. I did a test as I always do and I'm returning before I threw out the box because not all the coils heat even on high and the ones that do heat are inconsistent with certainly not what I would consider high temperatures after half an hour, some cold to the touch in certain areas. I expected  an electric blanket to heat consistently using both controllers across the board like my old one that was a different brand , this is not even worth the hassle of putting it back in the box but I'm not spending the on something that may or may not. The manufacturer seems to really be going downhill regarding quality on many of their products which is sad because they used to be a I name you could count on.... do not buy
